Cowork 上手實戰The Cowork Playbook

跟著做，套用到你的日常Do it. Then make it yours.

不只是會聊天的 AI，是會動手幫你把事做完的代理式 Copilot。Not an AI that just chats — the agentic Copilot that gets the work done.

6 個真實業務情境，從讀檔、寫文件、跑數據到對外溝通，帶你看 Cowork 如何自己規劃、執行，並在每個對外動作前停下來等你核准。看完就動手，再換成你自己的工作。6 real business scenarios — from reading files and writing documents to crunching data and communicating outbound. Watch Cowork plan, execute, and pause for your approval before every outbound action. Then make it your own.

零售通路 · 營運督導Retail · Store Operations

全通路戰情日報排程Scheduled Omnichannel Daily Brief

⏱ 約 12–15 分鐘 · 難度 ★★☆⏱ ~12–15 min · Level ★★☆

這個情境的重點不是「今天幫我做一份日報」，而是「從明天起，每個上班日早上 8:30，你自己把日報做好貼到 Teams 營運頻道」。先在對話中把一次的產出調到滿意，再把同一段指令設成排程任務 —— 這是 Copilot Chat 結構上做不到的：Chat 每次都要你重新開啟、重新貼資料、重新下指令，而 Cowork 排程任務在你還沒打開電腦前就已經跑完。The point here is not "make me a daily brief today" but "from tomorrow, at 8:30 every working day, produce this brief yourself and post it to the Teams operations channel." First tune one run in the conversation until the output is right, then turn that same instruction into a scheduled task — something Copilot Chat structurally cannot do. Chat needs you to reopen it, re-attach the data and re-type the instruction every single time; a Cowork scheduled task has already finished before you open your laptop.

會用到的技能Skills usedExcelCommunications排程任務Scheduled task

🎯情境背景Scenario

你是連鎖生活通路的營運督導，負責 8 家門市與 4 個電商通路。每天早上第一件事，就是把昨日的門市 POS 銷售、電商後台數據、以及各店回報的突發狀況拼在一起，判斷哪幾家落後、哪些事情要立刻處理，再貼到 Teams 營運頻道讓所有店長看到。這件事每天做、格式固定、判讀規則也固定 —— 正因為如此，它才是最不該由人每天手動重做的工作。這個情境示範：先跑一次確認品質，再把它變成每天自動執行的排程任務，你只需要在核准卡上按一下。You are the operations supervisor of a lifestyle retail chain, covering 8 stores and 4 online channels. The first thing every morning is stitching together yesterday's store POS sales, the ecommerce back-office numbers and the incidents each store reported, deciding which stores are behind and what needs immediate action, then posting it to the Teams operations channel so every store manager sees the same picture. It happens daily, the format is fixed and the rules for reading the numbers are fixed — which is exactly why a human should not be rebuilding it by hand every morning. This scenario shows you how to get one run right, then turn it into a scheduled task that runs itself every day, leaving you only an approval to click.

📂參考檔案Reference files

  • 📎RET1_全通路日銷售數據.xlsxRET1_Omnichannel_Daily_Sales.xlsx兩張工作表：門市 POS 日銷售（含當日目標與前四週同日平均）、電商通路日銷售（含退貨與轉換率）Two sheets: store POS daily sales (with daily target and prior 4-week same-day average) and ecommerce daily sales (with returns and conversion)
  • 📎RET1_門市回報與日報格式.mdRET1_Store_Feedback_and_Brief_Format.md各店當日回報事項、異常判讀規則（達成率門檻、客流結構異動、退貨異常）與戰情快報的五段格式Store feedback for the day, the anomaly rules (achievement thresholds, traffic-mix shift, return anomaly) and the five-section brief format

下載後上傳到 Cowork，即可跟著下面的步驟操作。Download then upload to Cowork to follow the steps below.

🔧逐步操作Step by step

1

先跑一次：上傳兩份檔案，要求它嚴格套用判讀規則Run it once first: upload both files and require it to apply the rules strictly

先不要急著設排程。第一次一定要在對話中跑一次，看清楚它算得對不對、有沒有真的套用你給的門檻，而不是自己憑感覺挑幾家講。這一步的價值在於：你是在「調校未來每天都會跑的那段指令」，現在多花三分鐘確認，之後每天都省下二十分鐘。Do not jump straight to scheduling. Always do one run in the conversation first, so you can see whether the math is right and whether it genuinely applied the thresholds you gave rather than picking a few stores by feel. The value of this step is that you are tuning the exact instruction that will run every day from now on — three extra minutes now saves twenty minutes every morning afterwards.

提示詞Prompt
附件是昨日全通路銷售數據與門市回報。請嚴格依照「門市回報與日報格式」中的異常判讀規則，計算每家門市的達成率與客單價、電商各通路的退貨率，標示嚴重落後、落後、客流結構異動與退貨異常的項目，再依文件中的五段格式產出一份戰情快報。每個結論都要對應到具體數字。Attached are yesterday's omnichannel sales data and the store feedback. Please apply the anomaly rules in the "store feedback and brief format" document strictly: calculate each store's achievement rate and average ticket, and the return rate for each ecommerce channel; flag items that are severely behind, behind, showing a traffic-mix shift, or showing a return anomaly; then produce the brief using the five-section format in the document. Every conclusion must tie back to a specific number.
2

抽查它有沒有真的套用門檻，而不是憑感覺挑Spot-check that it truly applied the thresholds rather than picking by feel

重點抽查三件事：桃園中壢店（達成率 62.8%）有沒有被標成「嚴重落後」；高雄左營店來客暴增但客單價偏低，它是把這家店當成業績亮眼，還是有看出「量增、值降」的結構訊號；以及門市回報中提到的施工、設備、缺貨，有沒有被拉進當日追蹤事項並指定負責人。特別留意左營這題：依規則需同時滿足「來客較前四週同日平均 +20% 以上」與「客單價低於全店平均 15% 以上」，而範例數據刻意設計成剛好卡在門檻邊緣，正確做法是列為臨界觀察並說明差距，而不是硬標成異動 —— 這一題就是在看它會不會為了「有結論」而放寬你給的門檻。Spot-check three things: is Taoyuan Zhongli (achievement 62.8%) flagged as "severely behind"? For Kaohsiung Zuoying — traffic way up but average ticket low — does it treat the store as a strong day, or does it recognize the "volume up, value down" signal? And did the construction, equipment and stock-out items in the store feedback get pulled into the follow-up list with a named owner? Pay particular attention to the Zuoying case: the rule requires BOTH "traffic up more than 20% versus the prior 4-week same-day average" AND "average ticket more than 15% below the chain average," and the sample data is deliberately set right at the edge of that threshold. The correct handling is to list it as a borderline observation with the gap stated, rather than forcing an anomaly label — this question tests whether it will loosen your threshold just to produce a conclusion.

3

把同一段指令設成每個上班日 08:30 的排程任務Turn the same instruction into a scheduled task at 08:30 every working day

確認品質之後，直接用一句話把它變成排程。Cowork 會建立一個排程任務，並問你要「立即啟用並執行一次」還是「等到下一個排定時間才第一次執行」。建立後可以在左側「自動化」頁看到它，有「執行紀錄」與「管理排程」兩個分頁，可以編輯、暫停、恢復或刪除。注意排程數量上限是 5 個，所以要留給真正每天重複的工作。Once the quality is confirmed, turn it into a schedule with one sentence. Cowork creates a scheduled task and asks whether to "activate and run now" or "activate" so the first run happens at the next scheduled time. After creation you will find it on the Automations page in the left navigation, which has a Runs tab and a Manage schedules tab where you can edit, pause, resume or delete it. Note the limit of five scheduled prompts — save them for work that genuinely repeats every day.

提示詞Prompt
請把剛才這份戰情快報設成排程任務：每個上班日早上 8:30 執行，讀取我 OneDrive 的當日全通路銷售數據與門市回報，用同一套判讀規則與五段格式產出快報，並貼到 Teams 的「營運戰情」頻道。貼文前一定要先讓我核准。Please set this brief up as a scheduled task: run at 8:30 every working day, read that day's omnichannel sales data and store feedback from my OneDrive, produce the brief using the same rules and five-section format, and post it to the "Operations" channel in Teams. Always ask for my approval before posting.
4

觀察貼文前的核准卡：排程不等於放手Watch the approval card before posting: scheduled does not mean unattended

排程任務跑起來之後，貼到 Teams 這一步仍然屬於對外動作，Cowork 會停在核准卡，把要貼的完整內容顯示給你看。這是很多人對「自動化」最大的誤解 —— 它不是放手不管，而是「準備好、等你點頭」。官方文件也明確說明：自動化任務預設是 draft-and-approve，且以你的權限執行、只看得到你看得到的資料。另外值得留意一個實測觀察：判讀規則第 3 條需要「前四週同日平均來客數」，但範例資料只提供了平均銷售額 —— Cowork 會在快報中明白註記這項限制、改用銷售額成長率近似判讀，而不是默默編一個來客數出來。你在自己的資料上跑時也該檢查這件事：**規則要用的欄位，資料裡是不是真的有**。Once the scheduled task runs, posting to Teams is still an outbound action, so Cowork stops at an approval card showing the full content it wants to post. This is the biggest misconception about "automation" — it is not hands-off; it is "prepared and waiting for your nod." The documentation states this explicitly: automated tasks default to draft-and-approve, run with your permissions, and see only what you can see. One observation worth noting from our test run: rule 3 requires "prior 4-week same-day average traffic," but the sample data only provides average sales — Cowork flags this limitation in the brief and falls back to a sales-growth approximation, rather than quietly inventing a traffic figure. Check the same thing on your own data: **does it actually contain the fields your rules depend on?**

⚠️審核決策點Approval checkpoint

在 Excel 中計算與判讀屬於內部整理，不會觸發審核卡；但「貼到 Teams 營運頻道」是對外動作，無論是你手動執行還是排程自動觸發，Cowork 都會先停在核准卡，顯示完整貼文內容讓你確認。這正是排程任務最重要的安全設計：任務會自己準備好，但送出前仍需要人。若你確定每天內容型態一致，可在核准卡的下拉選單選擇本次工作階段內不再詢問，但這個選擇只在該工作階段有效。Calculating and interpreting in Excel is internal work and triggers no approval card. But "posting to the Teams operations channel" is an outbound action — whether you run it by hand or the schedule fires it, Cowork stops at an approval card showing the full post for you to confirm. This is the key safety design of scheduled tasks: the task prepares itself, but a human still stands between it and the send. If you are confident the content type is consistent, the dropdown next to the action button lets you skip prompts for similar actions — but only within that session.

✅產出驗收Verify the result

  • 達成率、客單價、退貨率的計算與原始數據一致，桃園中壢店被正確標為嚴重落後Achievement rate, average ticket and return rate match the raw data, and Taoyuan Zhongli is correctly flagged as severely behind
  • 高雄左營店未被含糊帶過：不論標為臨界觀察或客流結構異動，都要說明來客成長與客單價偏離的具體數字Kaohsiung Zuoying is not glossed over: whether labeled a borderline observation or a traffic-mix shift, the traffic growth and average-ticket deviation are stated with specific figures
  • 門市回報中的施工、設備、缺貨都被拉進當日追蹤事項並指定負責人The construction, equipment and stock-out items from store feedback all appear as follow-up items with named owners
  • 若原始資料缺少判讀所需欄位，有誠實註記而非用推估數字補足Where the source data lacks a field the rules require, this is honestly noted rather than filled with an estimate
  • 排程任務已成功建立，可在「自動化」頁看到並能編輯、暫停或刪除The scheduled task is created and visible on the Automations page, where it can be edited, paused or deleted
  • 貼文到 Teams 前確實出現核准卡，內容與快報一致，沒有自動送出An approval card genuinely appears before posting to Teams, its content matches the brief, and nothing is sent automatically

💡延伸你的工作Extend to your work

  • 把排程改成一週一次的週報，或改成只在達成率低於 90% 時才通知你。Change the schedule to a weekly report, or have it notify you only when the achievement rate falls below 90%.
  • 請它在快報最後加一段「與上週同日比較」，讓趨勢一起呈現。Ask it to add a "versus the same day last week" section at the end so the trend shows alongside the numbers.
  • 若你的門市回報在 Teams 而不是檔案裡，可改用 Enterprise Search 直接抓頻道訊息。If your store feedback lives in Teams rather than a file, switch to Enterprise Search to pull the channel messages directly.
🎉
零售通路 · 商品企劃Retail · Merchandising

檔期促銷專案啟動包Campaign Launch Kit in One Pass

⏱ 約 20–30 分鐘 · 難度 ★★☆⏱ ~20–30 min · Level ★★☆

一句交辦，一次拿到四份不同格式的交付物：企劃書 Word、折扣毛利試算 Excel、門市執行 SOP PDF、供應商通知信草稿 —— 而且四份彼此數字一致。這正是 Cowork 與 Chat 最直觀的差別：Chat 一次給你一段文字，你得自己開四個檔、貼四次、對四次數字；Cowork 在同一個工作階段裡接力四個技能，最後用「全部下載」一次打包給你。One instruction, four deliverables in different formats: a Word campaign plan, an Excel discount-and-margin model, a PDF store execution SOP and a supplier notification email draft — with consistent numbers across all four. This is the most tangible difference between Cowork and Chat: Chat gives you one block of text at a time, and you open four files, paste four times and reconcile the numbers four times. Cowork relays four skills inside one session and hands the whole set back with Download All.

會用到的技能Skills usedWordExcelPDFEmail

🎯情境背景Scenario

你是商品企劃，秋季檔期要啟動了。過去每次檔期啟動，你都要分別生出企劃書給主管看、試算表給財務看、執行 SOP 給門市看、通知信給供應商看 —— 四份文件、四種語氣、四種格式，最麻煩的是折扣一改，四份都要重改一次，還常常改漏。這個情境示範：把需求單與商品成本清單一起交給 Cowork，讓它一次把四份交付物做齊，且共用同一份試算基礎，任何一個數字改動都能要求它整組重出，而不是你手動同步四個檔案。You are a merchandising planner and the autumn campaign is about to launch. Every campaign, you separately produce a plan for your manager, a model for finance, an execution SOP for stores and a notification for suppliers — four documents, four tones, four formats. The worst part is that when one discount changes, all four need reworking, and something always gets missed. This scenario shows you how to hand Cowork the requirement brief together with the product cost list and get all four deliverables in one pass, sharing a single calculation basis, so any change can be re-issued as a set instead of manually synced across four files.

📂參考檔案Reference files

🔧逐步操作Step by step

1

一次交辦四份交付物，並明確點名限制條件Commission all four deliverables at once, naming the constraints explicitly

這一步刻意不拆成四次對話。把需求單與成本清單一起上傳，一次講清楚要四份什麼格式的東西，並且明確要求它先驗算毛利率再提折扣建議。限制條件（毛利率不得低於 32%、庫存低於 300 件不得列主打、折後售價不得低於成本 1.25 倍）一定要在第一次就講，否則它會先做出一份好看但踩線的方案，你再花時間退回。Deliberately do not split this into four conversations. Upload the requirement brief and the cost list together, state all four deliverables and their formats in one go, and explicitly require it to verify the margin before proposing discounts. State the constraints up front (margin not below 32%, no hero SKU with stock under 300 units, discounted price not below 1.25x cost) — otherwise you will get a polished plan that breaks a rule, and spend time sending it back.

提示詞Prompt
附件是秋季檔期需求單與商品成本清單。請一次產出需求單中列出的四份交付物：（1）Word 檔期促銷企劃書；（2）Excel 品項折扣與毛利試算表；（3）PDF 門市執行 SOP，單張可張貼；（4）供應商配合通知信草稿。所有折扣建議都要先驗算，務必守住「整體毛利率不得低於 32%」「庫存低於 300 件不得列為主打品」「折後售價不得低於成本 1.25 倍」三個限制，四份文件的數字必須一致。Attached are the autumn campaign requirement brief and the product cost list. Please produce all four deliverables listed in the brief in one pass: (1) a Word campaign plan; (2) an Excel discount and margin model; (3) a PDF store execution SOP that fits on one page; (4) a supplier notification email draft. Verify the math behind every discount, and respect all three constraints — overall margin not below 32%, no hero SKU with stock under 300 units, and discounted price not below 1.25x cost. The numbers must be consistent across all four documents.
2

看它怎麼接力：側邊欄的技能與輸出資料夾同步長出來Watch the relay: the skills and output folder grow in the side panel

這一步請你刻意觀察右側工作區。隨著它從 Excel 試算換到 Word 撰寫、再到 PDF 排版與 Email 草擬，「技能」區會一個一個亮起技能標籤，「輸出」區會一份一份長出檔案。這個畫面就是 Cowork 與 Chat 最直觀的差別 —— 你看得到它在同一個任務裡換工具，而不是每次都要你重新交代一次背景。For this step, deliberately watch the side panel. As it moves from calculating in Excel to writing in Word, then laying out the PDF and drafting the email, skill chips light up one by one in the Skills section and files appear one by one in the Output folder. That view is the most tangible difference from Chat — you can see it switching tools inside a single task, instead of you re-explaining the background every time.

3

抽查毛利紅線與四份文件的數字一致性Spot-check the margin floor and cross-document consistency

打開 Excel 試算表，先確認整體毛利率是否真的守在 32% 以上、有沒有品項折後售價跌破成本 1.25 倍、庫存 190 件的鑄鐵鍋與 280 件的床頭燈有沒有被錯誤列為主打品。再交叉比對：企劃書寫的折扣數、SOP 上的贈品門檻、通知信裡的備貨量，是不是都跟試算表對得起來。這一步會出現兩種結果：它回報全部通過，或它主動指出某處不一致並修正 —— 兩種都算正常。AI 每次產出的內容不會完全相同，所以重點不是「它這次有沒有出錯」，而是「你有沒有真的去查」。這也正是四份文件共用同一份試算基礎的價值：不一致一旦被指出，可以請它整組重出，而不是你手動同步四個檔案。Open the Excel model first: does the overall margin genuinely hold at or above 32%, does any SKU's discounted price fall below 1.25x cost, and were the cast-iron pot (190 units) and bedside lamp (280 units) wrongly listed as hero items? Then cross-check: do the discount figures in the plan, the gift threshold on the SOP and the stock build in the supplier email all reconcile with the model? This step has two possible outcomes: it reports that everything passes, or it proactively flags an inconsistency and fixes it — both are normal. AI output differs slightly on every run, so the point is not whether it made a mistake this time but whether you actually checked. This is also exactly why all four documents share one calculation basis: once an inconsistency surfaces, you can have the whole set re-issued instead of manually syncing four files.

提示詞Prompt
請幫我逐項檢查：整體毛利率是否守住 32%？有沒有任何品項折後售價低於成本的 1.25 倍？有沒有庫存低於 300 件的品項被列為主打品？另外請確認企劃書、SOP 與供應商通知信裡出現的折扣數與贈品門檻，是否都與試算表一致，若有不一致請直接指出並修正。Please check each item for me: does the overall gross margin hold at 32%? Is any SKU's discounted price below 1.25x cost? Is any SKU with stock under 300 units listed as a hero item? Also confirm that the discount figures and gift thresholds appearing in the plan, the SOP and the supplier email all match the model — point out and fix any inconsistency.
4

用「全部下載」一次打包，供應商信留在草稿等你決定Use Download All to take the set, leaving the supplier email as a draft

四份檔案確認無誤後，在側邊欄輸出區點「全部下載」，一次打包成 zip（單次最多 50 個檔案、500 MB）。這裡刻意保留一個決策點：供應商通知信先停在草稿，因為對外寄給供應商屬於商業承諾，應該由你確認檔期條件真的定案後才送出，而不是在企劃還在內部討論階段就發出去。Once all four are verified, use Download All in the Output section of the side panel to take them as a single zip (up to 50 files and 500 MB per archive). One decision point is deliberately preserved: the supplier email stays as a draft, because sending it commits you commercially — it should go out only after you confirm the campaign terms are final, not while the plan is still under internal discussion.

提示詞Prompt
四份文件確認無誤。請把供應商通知信先存成草稿不要寄出，我需要等檔期條件正式定案後再自行發送。All four documents look correct. Please save the supplier notification as a draft rather than sending it — I will send it myself once the campaign terms are formally confirmed.

⚠️審核決策點Approval checkpoint

產生 Word、Excel、PDF 三份檔案都屬於內部產出，不會觸發核准卡；但「寄出供應商通知信」是對外動作，會停在核准卡，顯示收件者、主旨與完整內文。本情境刻意示範另一種更保守的做法：直接請它存成草稿不要寄，把最終決定權留在你手上 —— 因為對供應商的通知一旦發出，就等同對外承諾檔期條件。Producing the Word, Excel and PDF files is internal output and triggers no approval card. Sending the supplier notification is an outbound action and stops at an approval card showing recipients, subject and full body. This scenario deliberately demonstrates an even more conservative option: ask it to save the email as a draft instead, keeping the final call with you — because once a supplier notification goes out, the campaign terms are effectively committed.

零售通路 · 客服中心Retail · Customer Service

客訴事件觸發分流Event-Driven Complaint Triage

⏱ 約 15–18 分鐘 · 難度 ★★★⏱ ~15–18 min · Level ★★★

這個情境設定的不是排程，而是**事件觸發**：不是「每天早上跑一次」，而是「只要客服信箱收到符合條件的客訴信，就自動比對退換貨政策、判定案件等級、草擬回覆並等你核准」。你不用盯著信箱，也不用記得政策第幾條 —— 因為在你打開那封信之前，草稿已經準備好躺在那裡了。This scenario is not about a schedule but about an **event trigger**: not "run once every morning" but "whenever a matching complaint lands in the service inbox, check it against the returns policy, assign a severity level, draft a reply and wait for approval." You do not need to watch the inbox, and you do not need to remember which clause applies — by the time you open the email, the draft is already sitting there.

會用到的技能Skills usedEmailEnterprise Search事件觸發任務Event-driven task

🎯情境背景Scenario

你是客服主管，最痛的不是「不會回」，而是「回得慢、回得不一致」。同一種瑕疵退貨，資深專員引用 P-03 說運費公司負擔，新人卻請客戶自付；客戶已經催第三次了，案件卻還卡在 B 級沒有升級。這個情境示範 Cowork 最新、也最難被 Chat 取代的一種用法：設定事件觸發任務，讓它在客訴信進來的當下，就依照你們的政策條文完成比對、分級與草稿，你要做的只剩最後判斷 —— 而每一封信要不要送出，仍然是你按下去的。You run the customer service team. The pain is not "we do not know how to reply" but "we reply slowly and inconsistently." For the same defective return, a senior agent cites P-03 and says the company covers return shipping, while a new hire asks the customer to pay. A customer has chased three times and the case is still sitting at level B without escalation. This scenario demonstrates the newest Cowork capability that Chat cannot replicate: set up an event-driven task so that the moment a complaint arrives, the policy match, severity grading and draft reply are already done against your own clauses. All that is left is your judgement — and whether each reply goes out is still your click.

下載後上傳到 Cowork，即可跟著下面的步驟操作。Download then upload to Cowork to follow the steps below.

🔧逐步操作Step by step

1

先手動跑一次：三封信一起丟，看它的分級與引用對不對Do a manual run first: hand it all three emails and check the grading and citations

事件觸發任務最怕的是「規則沒調好就上線」，所以第一步一定是手動驗證。把三封客訴信與政策文件一起上傳，要求它逐封判定適用條款、案件等級與處理時效。三封信刻意設計成不同判斷點：第一封是瑕疵且已逾 48 小時未回覆（應為 A 級）、第二封是到貨逾期（適用 P-04，不受鑑賞期限制）、第三封是門市退貨的認知落差（適用 P-02，但需要說清楚差異）。The biggest risk with an event-driven task is putting it live before the rules are tuned, so step one is always manual verification. Upload the three complaint emails together with the policy document and ask it to determine the applicable clause, severity level and response deadline for each. The three emails are deliberately designed around different judgement points: the first is a defect with no reply for over 48 hours (should be level A), the second is a late delivery (P-04 applies, independent of the inspection period), and the third is a misunderstanding of the in-store return rule (P-02 applies, but the difference must be explained clearly).

提示詞Prompt
附件是三封客訴來信與我們的退換貨政策與處理原則。請逐封判定：適用哪一條政策（列出條款編號）、案件屬於 A／B／C 哪一級、首次回覆時效、以及是否需要主管覆核或內部通知。請用表格呈現判定結果，並簡述判定理由。Attached are three customer complaint emails and our returns policy and handling principles. For each one, determine: which clause applies (cite the ID), whether the case is level A, B or C, the first response deadline, and whether supervisor review or an internal notification is required. Present the determinations in a table with a short rationale for each.
2

請它依三段結構草擬回覆，並檢查有沒有超出政策承諾Have it draft replies in the three-part structure and check for over-promising

判定正確之後，再請它逐封草擬回覆。這裡最該檢查的不是文筆，而是「有沒有承諾政策以外的東西」。例如第一封客戶語氣不滿、要求全額退款又問運費，草稿如果自作主張加碼補償（送折價券、額外賠償），就是踩到「不承諾政策以外補償」這條原則；第三封則要看它有沒有誠實說明門市與網路通路規定不同，而不是含糊帶過或反過來怪客戶沒看清楚。Once the determinations are right, have it draft each reply. What matters here is not the prose but whether it promises anything beyond policy. In the first email the customer is unhappy, wants a full refund and asks about shipping — if the draft throws in extra compensation (a voucher, additional redress) on its own initiative, it has broken the "no compensation beyond policy" principle. In the third, check whether it honestly explains that in-store and online rules differ, rather than glossing over it or implying the customer should have read more carefully.

提示詞Prompt
請依「先致歉、再說明、最後給明確下一步」的三段結構，為這三封客訴各草擬一封回覆。每封都要明確引用適用條款編號，寫出公司將採取的動作、客戶需要配合的動作與預計完成時間。不要承諾政策以外的補償，若客戶要求超出政策範圍，請標記為需主管裁量。Please draft a reply to each of the three complaints using the three-part structure: apologize, explain, then give a clear next step. Each must cite the applicable clause ID and state what the company will do, what the customer needs to do, and the expected completion time. Do not promise compensation beyond policy — if a request falls outside policy, flag it for supervisor discretion.
3

把驗證過的規則設成事件觸發任務Turn the verified rules into an event-driven task

規則驗證過了，才把它變成常駐的事件觸發任務。Cowork 會跳出一張「設定觸發程序？」卡片，讓你確認三件事：**When**（觸發事件，這裡是收到符合條件的郵件）、**Run in**（每次觸發要開新對話還是延續目前這個）、**What it does**（觸發時要執行的指令）。卡片也會列出這個任務需要的權限，例如代表你寄信。看過之後按「設定」才會啟用。Only after the rules are verified do you make it a standing event-driven task. Cowork presents a "Set up trigger?" card asking you to confirm three things: **When** (the triggering event — here, receiving a matching email), **Run in** (whether each run starts a new conversation or continues this one), and **What it does** (the instruction to follow when it fires). The card also lists the permissions the task needs, such as sending email on your behalf. It arms only after you review it and select Set up.

提示詞Prompt
請設定一個事件觸發任務：當我的信箱收到主旨或內文包含「退貨」「瑕疵」「到貨延遲」「客訴」的來信時，自動依照我們的退換貨政策判定適用條款與案件等級，並用剛才那套三段結構草擬回覆，寄出前一定要先讓我核准。若判定為 A 級案件，請在草稿開頭標註「A 級，需主管覆核」。Please set up an event-driven task: when an email arrives whose subject or body contains "return", "defective", "late delivery" or "complaint", automatically determine the applicable clause and severity level against our returns policy, and draft a reply using the three-part structure we just used. Always ask for my approval before sending. If the case is graded level A, mark the top of the draft with "Level A — supervisor review required."
4

在「自動化」頁確認狀態，並理解它的安全邊界Check its state on the Automations page and understand the safety boundaries

事件觸發任務會和排程任務並列在「自動化」頁，各自顯示狀態（作用中／草稿／已暫停）與最近一次觸發時間，可以點進去看執行紀錄、編輯、暫停或刪除。有四件事一定要讓學員知道：任務以**你的權限**執行、只看得到你看得到的資料；預設是 draft-and-approve；系統有**速率限制與迴圈防護**，不會被自己觸發的信件無限引爆；所有活動都會寫入稽核記錄並受 Purview 政策約束。實測還觀察到兩個值得知道的細節：一是系統層的信件過濾**只能比對主旨**，所以 Cowork 會改成監看整個收件匣、由判定流程再檢查主旨與內文關鍵字，不相關的信件直接略過不產生草稿；二是同一寄件者短時間內的連續來信會被合併為一次處理，避免同一件事冒出好幾份草稿 —— 這正是「速率限制與迴圈防護」在實際運作的樣子。Event-driven tasks sit alongside scheduled prompts on the Automations page, each showing its state (Active, Draft or Paused) and when it last fired; open one to review its run history, edit, pause or delete it. Four points are essential for learners: the task runs with **your permissions** and sees only what you can see; it defaults to draft-and-approve; the platform applies **rate limits and loop protection** so a task cannot detonate on its own output; and all activity is written to the unified audit log and governed by Purview policies. Two further details surfaced in our test run: the system-level mail filter can only match on the subject line, so Cowork instead watches the whole inbox and has its own logic check both subject and body keywords, skipping unrelated mail without producing a draft; and consecutive messages from the same sender within a short window are consolidated into one run, so one issue does not spawn several drafts — that is rate limiting and loop protection in practice.

⚠️審核決策點Approval checkpoint

判定案件等級、比對政策、草擬回覆都屬於準備工作，不會觸發核准卡；真正的界線在「寄出」。事件觸發任務預設就是 draft-and-approve：當任務要寄信、發 Teams 訊息或變更共用系統時，Cowork 會先把動作準備好再請你核准。客訴回覆尤其不建議設為自動送出 —— 回信內容一旦寄出就代表公司立場，A 級案件更明確要求主管覆核。Grading the case, matching the policy and drafting the reply are all preparation and trigger no approval card; the real boundary is sending. Event-driven tasks default to draft-and-approve: when a task would send an email, post in Teams or change a shared system, Cowork prepares the action and asks for approval first. Complaint replies in particular should never be set to auto-send — once a reply goes out it represents the company's position, and level A cases explicitly require supervisor review.

✅產出驗收Verify the result

  • 第一封（瑕疵且逾 48 小時未回覆）被正確判定為 A 級並要求主管覆核The first email (defect, no reply for over 48 hours) is correctly graded level A with supervisor review required
  • 第二封正確引用 P-04，說明到貨逾期可取消並全額退款，不受鑑賞期限制The second correctly cites P-04, explaining that a late delivery can be cancelled for a full refund regardless of the inspection period
  • 第三封誠實說明門市（P-02）與網路通路（P-01）規定不同，未含糊帶過也未責怪客戶The third honestly explains that in-store (P-02) and online (P-01) rules differ, without glossing over it or blaming the customer
  • 三封回覆都明確引用條款編號，且未承諾政策以外的補償All three replies cite clause IDs and none promises compensation beyond policy
  • 事件觸發任務已建立，可在「自動化」頁看到狀態與執行紀錄The event-driven task is created and its state and run history are visible on the Automations page
  • 確認任務為 draft-and-approve，沒有任何一封信被自動寄出The task is confirmed as draft-and-approve, and no reply was sent automatically

💡延伸你的工作Extend to your work

  • 把觸發條件縮小到特定寄件網域或特定通路的客服信箱，降低誤觸發。Narrow the trigger to a specific sender domain or one channel's service mailbox to reduce false fires.
  • 加一條規則：同一品號 30 天內第 3 件瑕疵客訴時，另外通知商品企劃與品保。Add a rule: on the third defect complaint for the same SKU within 30 days, additionally notify merchandising and QA.
  • 改成 Teams 觸發，例如當你在客訴處理頻道被 @提及時自動整理案件脈絡。Switch to a Teams trigger — for example, compile the case context automatically when you are @mentioned in the complaints channel.

零售通路 · 商品定價Retail · Pricing

競品情報與調價建議Competitive Intelligence to Pricing Actions

⏱ 約 40–90 分鐘 · 難度 ★★★⏱ ~40–90 min · Level ★★★

Deep Research 的價值不在「查到很多資料」，而在「查完之後要能落到你自己的數字上」。這個情境刻意把外部情報與內部毛利表接起來：先讓它做一輪有來源的公開市場情報，再要求它把每一條情報換算成「這個品項該不該調價、調多少、調完毛利率剩多少」，而且不准用推估數字填補查不到的空格 —— 查不到就必須誠實寫「查無可靠公開來源」。The value of Deep Research is not "finding a lot of material" but "landing what it found on your own numbers." This scenario deliberately connects external intelligence to your internal margin table: first run a sourced sweep of public market practice, then require every finding to be converted into "should this SKU be repriced, by how much, and what margin remains." And no filling gaps with estimates — where nothing reliable is found, it must honestly write "no reliable public source found."

會用到的技能Skills usedDeep ResearchExcel

🎯情境背景Scenario

你是商品企劃，每次檔期前主管都會問同一句話：「我們的價格在市場上到底算貴還是便宜？」過去的做法是自己開一堆分頁比價，比到一半發現忘了記來源，最後在會議上被問「這個數字哪來的」答不出來。更常見的問題是：查完之後只得到一堆「市場行情大約如何」的印象，卻沒有變成任何一個具體可執行的調價決定。這個情境把兩端綁在一起 —— Deep Research 負責帶回可查證的公開情報，Excel 負責把情報換算成守得住紅線的調價建議表。You are a merchandising planner, and before every campaign your manager asks the same question: "are our prices actually high or low in this market?" The old approach is opening a pile of tabs, losing track of where each figure came from, and then failing to answer "where did this number come from?" in the meeting. The more common failure is that after all that research you end up with a vague impression of market levels but not one concrete, executable pricing decision. This scenario ties both ends together: Deep Research brings back verifiable public intelligence, and Excel converts it into a pricing recommendation table that respects your hard limits.

📂參考檔案Reference files

  • 📎RET4_主力品項售價與毛利.xlsxRET4_Key_SKU_Price_and_Margin.xlsx8 個主力品項的我方售價、成本、毛利率與近四週銷售表現（競品參考價欄位刻意留待研究後補上）Eight key SKUs with our price, cost, gross margin and 4-week performance (the competitor reference price is deliberately left to be filled after the research)
  • 📎RET4_調價原則與情報需求.mdRET4_Pricing_Rules_and_Research_Brief.md四項情報蒐集需求、五條調價紅線（R-01～R-05，含 38% 毛利率下限）、交付欄位定義與引用要求Four research requirements, five pricing rules (R-01 to R-05, including the 38% margin floor), the deliverable column definitions and the citation requirement

下載後上傳到 Cowork，即可跟著下面的步驟操作。Download then upload to Cowork to follow the steps below.

🔧逐步操作Step by step

1

先做有來源的公開市場情報，明確要求查不到就標註Run the sourced market sweep first, requiring explicit gaps to be labeled

這一步只做研究，先不要碰價格決策。重點是把「引用要求」講死：每一條情報都要附可點擊來源連結，查不到可靠公開來源的就必須寫「查無可靠公開來源」，不准用看起來合理的數字填空。這一句話是整個情境的品質關鍵 —— 沒有它，你會拿到一份讀起來很完整、但沒辦法在會議上被追問的報告。另外要有心理準備：Deep Research 是本手冊最耗時的技能，實測跑完兩條研究線就花了近一小時，你可以先去做別的事，它會在背景跑完，也可以在「我的工作」看到進度。This step is research only — do not touch pricing decisions yet. The key is to nail down the citation requirement: every finding needs a clickable source link, and anything without a reliable public source must be written up as "no reliable public source found" rather than filled with a plausible-looking number. That single sentence is the quality lever for the whole scenario — without it you get a report that reads complete but cannot survive a follow-up question in the meeting. Also set your expectations: Deep Research is the most time-consuming skill in this playbook — in our test run the two research threads alone took close to an hour. You can go do something else; it keeps running in the background and you can check progress under My tasks.

提示詞Prompt
附件是我們的調價原則與情報需求。請依文件第二節的四項需求做一輪深度研究：同類型生活用品近三個月的公開促銷做法、各主要通路秋季檔期慣用的行銷主題與檔期長度、同類商品的公開零售價區間、以及消費者在生活用品類別的討論重點。每一條發現都必須附上可點擊的來源連結；若查不到可靠公開來源，請直接寫「查無可靠公開來源」，不要用推估數字填補。Attached are our pricing rules and research brief. Please run a deep research pass covering the four requirements in section 2: publicly published promotional practice for comparable home goods over the last three months, the marketing themes and campaign lengths major channels use for the autumn window, the public retail price range for comparable products, and recent consumer discussion themes in the category. Every finding must carry a clickable source link; where no reliable public source exists, write "no reliable public source found" rather than filling in an estimate.
2

檢查來源品質：連結是否可點、是否真的支持該結論Check source quality: are the links live and do they actually support the claim

隨機點開三到五個來源連結，確認兩件事：連結真的存在（不是看起來像網址的字串），以及該來源真的支持它寫的那句結論，而不是勉強沾邊。這一步是整個情境最重要的把關 —— 你要在這裡建立學員的習慣：AI 給的每一個外部數字，都要能被點開驗證，否則就不該被寫進要呈報主管的報告裡。Open three to five source links at random and confirm two things: the link genuinely resolves (rather than being a string that merely looks like a URL), and the source actually supports the sentence it is attached to rather than being loosely related. This is the single most important checkpoint in the scenario — it is where you build the habit that every external figure an AI produces must be clickable and verifiable before it goes into anything you show your manager.

3

把情報落到毛利表上，逐項給出守得住紅線的調價建議Land the intelligence on the margin table with rule-compliant recommendations

這一步才是這個情境真正的差異點：不是「幫我整理市場情報」，而是「把情報換算成我能執行的決定」。要求它在原始毛利表上長出六個新欄位，並且每一條建議都必須對應到 R-01～R-05 的原則編號。特別注意三個檢查點：鑄鐵燉鍋毛利率 41.3%，調降 15% 後會不會跌破 38% 紅線；銷量只有 88 與 96 件的兩個品項，有沒有被錯誤地建議降價（違反 R-03）；香氛蠟燭毛利率 59% 且銷量第一，有沒有被評估小幅調漲（R-04）。This is where the scenario genuinely differs: not "summarize market intelligence for me" but "convert it into decisions I can execute." Ask it to add six new columns to the original margin table, with every recommendation referencing a rule ID from R-01 to R-05. Watch three checkpoints in particular: the cast-iron pot sits at 41.3% margin — would a 15% cut breach the 38% floor? The two SKUs selling only 88 and 96 units — were they wrongly recommended for discounting, breaking R-03? And the scented candle at 59% margin and top of the units ranking — was it assessed for a small increase under R-04?

提示詞Prompt
請把上述研究結果套用到附件的主力品項毛利表，輸出成 Excel，新增這些欄位：競品參考價區間（附來源）、我方價格相對位置、建議動作、建議調整後售價、調整後毛利率、建議理由。每一條建議理由都必須對應到調價原則 R-01～R-05 的編號，並嚴格檢查調整後毛利率不得低於 38%、單次調降不得超過 15%。最後加一段整體建議摘要。Please apply the research above to the key-SKU margin table attached and output an Excel file with these added columns: competitor reference price range (with source), our relative position, recommended action, recommended new price, resulting gross margin, and rationale. Every rationale must reference a rule ID from R-01 to R-05, and you must strictly enforce that the resulting margin never falls below 38% and no single reduction exceeds 15%. Close with an overall recommendation summary.
4

讓它自我檢查紅線，並說明哪些品項刻意不動價Have it self-check the limits and explain which SKUs it deliberately left alone

最後補一刀自我檢查。這一步的用意不只是抓錯，更是讓報告能回答主管最愛問的那題：「為什麼這幾個不動？」一份只寫「建議降價」的報告會被打回票，一份能說明「這三個依 R-03 不建議降價，因為銷量低的問題不在價格而在陳列曝光」的報告，才是可以直接進會議的版本。Finish with a self-check pass. The point is not only catching errors but making the report able to answer the question managers always ask: "why did you leave these alone?" A report that only says "recommend a discount" gets sent back; one that explains "these three are not recommended for a cut under R-03, because their low volume is a display-and-exposure problem rather than a price problem" is a version you can take straight into the meeting.

提示詞Prompt
請自我檢查一次：有沒有任何建議違反 R-01（毛利率低於 38%）或 R-02（調降超過 15%）？並請列出哪些品項屬於「不建議動價、改用其他手段」，逐項說明理由與建議的替代做法。Please self-check once: does any recommendation breach R-01 (margin below 38%) or R-02 (a cut over 15%)? Also list which SKUs fall into "do not reprice, use another lever" and explain the reasoning and the alternative you recommend for each.

⚠️審核決策點Approval checkpoint

深度研究與 Excel 試算都屬於唯讀彙整，不會觸發核准卡。但這個情境的風險不在「送出」，而在「引用」—— 調價建議一旦被採用就會影響實際營收與毛利，因此外部情報的來源必須逐條可驗證。請把重點放在核實來源連結是否真的存在、是否真的支持該結論；若下一步要把建議寄給主管或供應商議價，才會進入寄送前的核准流程。Deep research and Excel modelling are read-only compilation and trigger no approval card. The risk in this scenario is not sending but citing — once a pricing recommendation is adopted it moves real revenue and margin, so every external finding must be independently verifiable. Focus on confirming that source links genuinely resolve and genuinely support the claim. Only when you go on to email the recommendations to your manager or use them in supplier negotiation does the approve-before-send flow apply.

✅產出驗收Verify the result

  • 每一條外部情報都附有可點擊來源連結，查不到的誠實標示「查無可靠公開來源」Every external finding carries a clickable source link, and gaps are honestly labeled "no reliable public source found"
  • 隨機抽查的來源連結真的可以打開，且內容支持它所寫的結論Randomly checked source links genuinely resolve and their content supports the stated conclusion
  • 所有建議調整後的毛利率都不低於 38%，單次調降幅度都未超過 15%Every recommended change leaves the margin at or above 38%, and no single reduction exceeds 15%
  • 近四週銷量低於 100 件的品項未被以降價作為第一手段（符合 R-03）SKUs selling under 100 units in four weeks were not discounted as the first move (R-03 respected)
  • 每條建議理由都對應到 R-01～R-05 的原則編號，而非空泛描述Every rationale references a rule ID from R-01 to R-05 rather than a vague description
  • 報告明確列出「不建議動價」的品項與替代做法，而非只給降價建議The report explicitly lists SKUs not recommended for repricing with alternative levers, not only discounts

💡延伸你的工作Extend to your work

  • 把調價紅線換成你們自己的毛利政策，其他步驟完全沿用。Swap in your own margin policy as the hard limit — every other step carries over unchanged.
  • 請它額外做一份「若競品再降 10%，我們的因應選項」的情境模擬。Ask for an additional scenario model: "if competitors cut another 10%, what are our options?"
  • 把研究結果設成每月排程，讓價格情報變成常態而不是檔期前的臨時作業。Put the research on a monthly schedule so price intelligence becomes routine rather than a scramble before each campaign.

零售通路 · 商品採購Retail · Procurement

合約到期盤點到會議發出Contract Sweep to Meetings Booked

⏱ 約 15–18 分鐘 · 難度 ★★★⏱ ~15–18 min · Level ★★★

這個情境要示範的是「一條龍」：從讀 PDF 合約清單、依規則算出誰已經逾期未啟動，到直接開會議邀請、寄提醒信給各採購 —— 三個不同系統（檔案、行事曆、郵件）在同一個任務裡串起來。Chat 能幫你算天數，但算完之後開會議、寄信這兩件事，永遠得你自己再做一次。This scenario demonstrates an end-to-end chain: read the PDF contract schedule, apply the rules to work out who is already past their start-work date, then actually create the meeting invitations and email each buyer a reminder — three different systems (files, calendar, mail) strung together inside one task. Chat can calculate the day counts for you, but booking the meetings and sending the emails afterwards always falls back to you.

會用到的技能Skills usedPDFCalendar ManagementEmail

🎯情境背景Scenario

你是商品採購部主管，手上有八份供應商合約，分別由三位採購負責。續約規則其實很清楚：年採購額 1,000 萬以上要提前 90 天啟動並開評估會議，300 萬到 1,000 萬提前 60 天，300 萬以下提前 30 天書面簽核。問題是沒有人會每週去翻那張 PDF 對日期，結果常常是到期前兩週才發現「這家早就該啟動了」，議價空間也跟著消失。這個情境把「盤點 → 排會議 → 通知」三段一次做完，而且每一個對外動作都會停在核准卡等你確認。You lead merchandising procurement, with eight supplier contracts spread across three buyers. The renewal rules are clear enough: contracts above NT$10M annual value start 90 days out with a review meeting, NT$3M-10M start 60 days out, and below NT$3M start 30 days out with written sign-off. The problem is that nobody re-reads that PDF against the calendar every week, so you routinely discover two weeks before expiry that a contract should have started months ago — and your negotiating leverage evaporates with it. This scenario completes all three stages — sweep, schedule, notify — in one pass, with every outbound action stopping at an approval card.

📂參考檔案Reference files

  • 📎RET5_供應商合約清單.pdfRET5_Supplier_Contract_Expiry_List.pdf八份供應商合約的到期日、年度採購額、負責採購與續約狀態（多數仍為「尚未啟動」）Eight supplier contracts with expiry date, annual purchase value, responsible buyer and renewal status (most still "not started")
  • 📎RET5_續約評估原則.mdRET5_Renewal_Assessment_Principles.md依採購額分級的提前啟動天數、五項評估項目、會議安排原則（時長與必要與會者）與提醒信要點Lead times by purchase value, five assessment criteria, meeting scheduling rules (duration and required attendees) and what each reminder email must contain

下載後上傳到 Cowork，即可跟著下面的步驟操作。Download then upload to Cowork to follow the steps below.

🔧逐步操作Step by step

1

讀 PDF 並依規則算出誰已經逾期未啟動Read the PDF and work out who is already past their start date

第一步是把兩份文件一起交出去，讓它自己讀 PDF、自己套規則、自己算天數。以今天 2026/08/20 為基準，香語生活（9/18 到期、年採購 690 萬、需提前 60 天）與綿境紡織（9/30 到期、年採購 1,280 萬、需提前 90 天）都已經逾期未啟動 —— 這正是這份清單刻意埋的判斷點，用來檢查它是真的在算日期，還是只是照著到期日先後排序。Step one hands over both documents and lets it read the PDF, apply the rules and compute the day counts itself. Against today's date of 2026/08/20, Xiangyu Living (expires 9/18, NT$6.9M annual, needs a 60-day lead) and Mianjing Textiles (expires 9/30, NT$12.8M annual, needs a 90-day lead) are both already past their start-work date — the judgement point deliberately planted in this list, to check whether it is genuinely computing dates or merely sorting by expiry.

提示詞Prompt
附件是供應商合約到期總表與續約評估原則。今天是 2026 年 8 月 20 日。請依原則中的分級規則，計算每一份合約的剩餘天數與「應啟動日」，並明確標示哪些合約的應啟動日已經過期卻仍為「尚未啟動」。請用表格呈現，依急迫程度排序。Attached are the supplier contract expiry schedule and the renewal assessment principles. Today is 20 August 2026. Using the tiering rules in the principles, calculate the days remaining and the "start work by" date for each contract, and explicitly flag any contract whose start date has already passed while its status is still "not started." Present this as a table sorted by urgency.
2

請它依規則安排續約評估會議，觀察行事曆技能接手Have it schedule the renewal review meetings and watch the calendar skill take over

確認盤點結果後，換技能。會議安排有明確規則：1,000 萬以上開 60 分鐘且採購主管必須出席，其餘 30 分鐘；物流合約要另外找營運部代表；同一位採購若有多份到期日相近（30 天內）的合約，可以合併成一場會議。請特別留意最後這條 —— 它是用來測試它有沒有真的讀規則：黃柏翰同時負責綿境紡織（9/30）與睡研寢具（10/15），兩者相差 15 天，依規則就該合併成一場。若它拆成兩場，代表規則沒被完整套用，把合併條件再講一次讓它重排即可。Once the sweep is confirmed, switch skills. The scheduling rules are explicit: 60 minutes with the procurement manager present for contracts above NT$10M, 30 minutes otherwise; logistics contracts also need an operations representative; and where one buyer holds several contracts expiring within 30 days of each other, those may be combined into a single meeting. Watch that last rule especially — it tests whether it actually read the principles: Huang Po-Han owns both Mianjing (9/30) and Sleeplab (10/15), just 15 days apart, so by the rule they should be combined. If it books two separate meetings, the rule was not fully applied — restate the combination condition and have it reschedule.

提示詞Prompt
請依續約評估原則第三節的規則，為需要開會的合約安排續約評估會議：年採購額 1,000 萬以上排 60 分鐘並邀請採購主管，其餘排 30 分鐘；物流合約另邀營運部代表；同一位採購若有多份合約到期日相近（30 天內），請合併為一場會議。會議請安排在未來兩週的工作日上午，並在邀請內文列出該場要討論的合約與五項評估項目。Following the rules in section 3 of the renewal principles, schedule the renewal review meetings for the contracts that require one: 60 minutes with the procurement manager for contracts above NT$10M annual value, 30 minutes otherwise; add an operations representative for logistics contracts; and combine contracts into one meeting where the same buyer holds several expiring within 30 days of each other. Book them on weekday mornings over the next two weeks, and list the contracts covered and the five assessment criteria in the invitation body.
3

核准每一個對外動作：會議邀請與提醒信逐一確認Approve each outbound action: invitations and reminder emails one by one

這一步是整個情境的核心體驗。建立會議邀請與寄送提醒信都是對外動作，Cowork 會逐一停在核准卡，顯示與會者、時間、主旨與完整內文。請刻意在這裡停久一點：檢查有沒有把會議排到週末、有沒有邀錯人、信裡的剩餘天數與合約編號是否對得上。這正是「代理 AI 幫你做完，但不代替你決定」的具體樣貌。This step is the core experience of the scenario. Creating calendar invitations and sending reminder emails are both outbound actions, so Cowork stops at an approval card for each one, showing attendees, times, subject and full body. Deliberately linger here: check that nothing landed on a weekend, that nobody was invited by mistake, and that the days-remaining figures and contract numbers in each email reconcile. This is what "agentic AI does the work but does not make the decision for you" concretely looks like.

提示詞Prompt
請為三位負責採購各寄一封提醒信，內容包含：他負責的合約清單（供應商、合約編號、到期日、剩餘天數）、應啟動日是否已經過期（過期請明確標示）、需要準備的五項評估資料、以及已安排的會議時間。語氣是內部工作提醒，直接具體、不用客套，並副本給我。Please send each of the three buyers a reminder email containing: the contracts they own (supplier, contract number, expiry date, days remaining), whether the start-work date has already passed (flag it explicitly if so), the five pieces of assessment material to prepare, and the scheduled meeting time. Keep the tone an internal work reminder — direct and specific, without pleasantries — and CC me.
4

回頭確認行事曆與寄件備份，驗證動作真的落地Verify in the calendar and sent items that the actions genuinely landed

最後一步請學員親自回 Outlook 行事曆與寄件備份確認。這不是多此一舉 —— 讓學員親眼看到「這些會議真的出現在我的行事曆、這些信真的寄出去了」，才會真正理解 Cowork 與 Chat 的差別：Chat 給你一段可以複製的文字，Cowork 直接在你的系統裡留下可查證的紀錄。同時也提醒：所有動作都以你的權限執行、都會寫入稽核記錄。這一步還有一個值得對照的觀察：範例中有三份合約的應啟動日還在幾個月後，實測時 Cowork **拒絕現在替它們排會**，理由是「會違反第三節『會議應安排在應啟動日之後』」，並主動說明可以先建立提醒。請刻意檢查它有沒有做到這件事 —— 一個好的代理不只是把你交辦的事做完，而是在你的指令與你自己訂的規則衝突時，會停下來告訴你。For the final step, have learners check their Outlook calendar and Sent Items themselves. This is not busywork — seeing with their own eyes that "those meetings really are in my calendar and those emails really did go out" is what makes the difference from Chat land: Chat gives you text to copy, Cowork leaves verifiable records inside your own systems. It is also the moment to reinforce that every action ran with your permissions and was written to the audit log. There is one more contrast worth checking here: three contracts in the sample have start-work dates months away, and in our test run Cowork **declined to schedule meetings for them now**, citing the section-3 rule that "the meeting must be scheduled after the start-work date," and offered to set reminders instead. Deliberately check whether it did this — a good agent does not just complete what you asked; it stops and tells you when your instruction conflicts with the rules you yourself wrote.

⚠️審核決策點Approval checkpoint

讀取 PDF、計算天數、判定逾期都屬於內部整理，不會觸發核准卡。但「建立會議邀請」與「寄送提醒信」都是對外動作，Cowork 會逐一停在核准卡顯示完整內容，你確認後才會真的送出。這個情境刻意安排多個核准點，讓學員實際體會官方文件所說的：核准卡會顯示風險等級，也可以用「更多選項」在本次工作階段內針對特定收件者或網域略過後續詢問 —— 但這個設定只在該工作階段有效，且可以在側邊欄「權限」區隨時檢視與撤銷。Reading the PDF, computing day counts and identifying overdue items are internal work and trigger no approval card. But creating calendar invitations and sending reminder emails are both outbound actions, so Cowork stops at an approval card with the full content for each, and nothing goes out until you confirm. This scenario deliberately includes several approval points so learners experience what the documentation describes: approval cards carry a risk-level indicator, and the More options dropdown can skip prompts for a specific recipient or domain — but only within that session, and always reviewable and revocable from the Permissions section of the side panel.

✅產出驗收Verify the result

  • 香語生活（9/18）與綿境紡織（9/30）被正確標示為「應啟動日已過期」Xiangyu Living (9/18) and Mianjing Textiles (9/30) are correctly flagged as past their start-work date
  • 提前啟動天數依年度採購額正確分級（90／60／30 天），未一律套用同一個天數Lead times are correctly tiered by annual purchase value (90/60/30 days) rather than one blanket figure
  • 黃柏翰的兩份到期日相近合約被合併為一場會議，符合合併規則Huang Po-Han's two closely-expiring contracts are combined into a single meeting, per the combination rule
  • 物流合約的會議另外邀請了營運部代表，會議時長依採購額正確設定The logistics contract meeting also invites an operations representative, and durations match the purchase-value rules
  • 每封提醒信的合約清單、剩餘天數與會議時間都與盤點結果一致Each reminder email's contract list, days remaining and meeting time match the sweep results
  • 應啟動日尚未到的合約沒有被硬排會議，且有說明原因而非默默略過Contracts whose start-work date has not arrived were not force-scheduled, and the reason was explained rather than silently skipped
  • 所有會議邀請與提醒信都經過核准卡逐一確認後才送出Every invitation and reminder email passed through an approval card before being sent

💡延伸你的工作Extend to your work

  • 把它設成每月 1 號的排程任務，讓合約盤點變成不需要人記得的例行工作。Put it on a schedule for the first of each month so the contract sweep becomes routine that nobody has to remember.
  • 請它額外整理一份「單一來源風險」清單，標出沒有替代供應商的品類。Ask for an additional "single-source risk" list highlighting categories with no alternative supplier.
  • 把合約清單換成你們自己的版本，續約規則寫進文件即可沿用整套流程。Swap in your own contract list — writing your renewal rules into the document reuses the entire flow.

門市週報產生器技能Store Weekly Report Skill

⏱ 約 20–25 分鐘 · 難度 ★★★⏱ ~20–25 min · Level ★★★

前面五個情境每次都要重講一次規則；這一個把規則本身變成資產。做一個自訂技能，一次寫清楚分級門檻、警訊規則、HTML 報表結構與語氣要求，之後每週只要一句「產生本週門市營運週報」，就同時拿到一份可視覺化的 HTML 報表與一份可直接寄出的 Email 版摘要 —— 而且同事也能用同一套標準，週報格式不會因人而異。The previous five scenarios re-explain the rules every time; this one turns the rules themselves into an asset. Build a custom skill that states the tier thresholds, alert rules, HTML report structure and tone requirements once, and from then on a single sentence — "generate this week's store operations report" — produces both a visual HTML report and a ready-to-send email summary. Better still, colleagues can use the same standard, so the report format no longer varies by author.

會用到的技能Skills used自訂技能 Skill

🎯情境背景Scenario

你是營運督導，門市營運週報你已經寫了兩年。格式固定、判讀規則固定、連語氣要求都固定 —— 唯一會變的只有那張原始數據表。但每次請 AI 幫忙，你都得重新交代一次「達成率 105% 以上叫領先、缺貨 10 次以上要列優先處理、不要用『表現亮眼』這種形容詞」，講到第三次就會開始懷疑自己在做什麼。這個情境示範把這些規則寫進 SKILL.md，讓它變成 Cowork 每次開新工作階段都會自動載入的能力，並且刻意把輸出升級成 HTML 視覺化報表 + Email 版摘要兩份，而不是只丟一份文字檔。You are an operations supervisor and you have been writing the store weekly report for two years. The format is fixed, the interpretation rules are fixed, even the tone requirements are fixed — the only thing that changes is the raw data table. Yet every time you ask an AI for help you re-explain that "105% and above is Leading, 10 or more stock-outs goes into priority actions, and do not use adjectives like outstanding" — and by the third time you start wondering what you are doing. This scenario writes those rules into a SKILL.md so they become a capability Cowork loads automatically at the start of every new session, and deliberately upgrades the output to two artifacts — a visual HTML report and an email summary — rather than a single block of text.

📂參考檔案Reference files

  • 📎RET6_SKILL.mdRET6_SKILL_EN.md完整的自訂技能範例：觸發時機、兩份產出物定義、計算與判讀規則、HTML 結構與樣式、Email 摘要結構、語氣要求與防護欄A complete custom skill example: trigger conditions, two output definitions, calculation and interpretation rules, HTML structure and styling, email summary structure, tone requirements and guardrails

下載後上傳到 Cowork，即可跟著下面的步驟操作。Download then upload to Cowork to follow the steps below.

🔧逐步操作Step by step

1

用引導式流程建立技能：先描述你每週在做什麼Create the skill through the guided flow: describe what you do every week

建立技能有三種方式：從左側「自訂」頁的引導式流程、直接在對話中請它幫你做一個、或自己在 OneDrive 的 `/Documents/Cowork/skills/` 底下放一個 SKILL.md。這一步用最直覺的第二種：直接把你每週的做法講給它聽，讓它幫你寫成技能草稿。重點是描述要包含「什麼時候該用這個技能」的觸發語句 —— 官方文件明確指出，描述沒有觸發語句是技能永遠不會被啟動的頭號原因。實測時還會看到一個容易被忽略的動作：它會主動比對你**既有的技能清單**，找出可能搶著觸發的那幾個（例如已經有的月報、週報類技能），並在描述裡寫進「Do NOT use for ⋯（改用某某技能）」的排除條款。這就是官方文件說的「衝突掃描」—— 兩個技能競爭同一批請求時，明確的委派可以把衝突判定為已解決。你自己建技能時也該問它這件事。There are three ways to create a skill: the guided flow on the Customize page, simply asking Cowork in chat to build one, or dropping a SKILL.md into `/Documents/Cowork/skills/` in your OneDrive. This step uses the most natural one — the second: describe what you do each week and let it draft the skill for you. The key is that the description must contain the trigger phrasing for when the skill should fire — the documentation names a description without trigger phrases as the number-one reason a skill never activates. Our test run also surfaced an easily-missed step: it proactively compares against your **existing skills**, identifies the ones likely to compete for the same requests (for example monthly- or weekly-report skills you already have), and writes explicit "Do NOT use for … (use skill X instead)" exclusions into the description. That is the "conflict scan" the documentation describes — when two skills compete for the same requests, an explicit handoff resolves the conflict. Ask for this when you build your own skills.

提示詞Prompt
我想建立一個自訂技能：門市營運週報產生器。當我提供門市週營運數據並要求產生營運週報時就使用它。它要同時產出兩份東西：一份單檔 HTML 視覺化週報（內嵌 CSS、不依賴外部資源），以及一份可直接貼進郵件的 Email 版摘要。請先幫我把技能的名稱與描述寫好，描述裡要包含明確的觸發語句。I want to create a custom skill: a store weekly operations report generator. It should fire when I provide weekly store operations data and ask for an operations weekly report. It must produce two things: a single-file visual HTML report (inlined CSS, no external dependencies) and an email summary that can be pasted straight into a message. Please start by writing the skill name and description, making sure the description contains explicit trigger phrasing.
2

把判讀規則與防護欄寫進去，這才是技能的價值所在Write in the interpretation rules and guardrails — this is where the value lives

技能的價值不在名字，而在規則的密度。參考附件的 SKILL.md 範例，把四類東西寫進去：**計算規則**（達成率怎麼算、店群四級門檻）、**警訊規則**（缺貨 10 次以上、客訴 5 件以上）、**輸出結構**（HTML 六段、Email 五段、主色與狀態色）、以及**防護欄**（不得加入原始資料沒有的數字、缺欄位要寫「本週未提供」而不是填 0、不使用沒有數據支撐的形容詞）。防護欄常被忽略，卻是決定這份報表能不能直接送出去的關鍵。⚠️ 這一步有個**一定要注意的操作**：技能寫好後，Cowork 會跳出一張「複製檔案」核准卡（把技能從暫存的 working 資料夾複製到正式的 skills 資料夾），**你必須手動按下「核准」，技能才會真的發布**。很多人以為它會自己跑完就離開畫面，結果技能其實從未建立成功。看到這張卡請先看清楚 Source 與 Destination 路徑，再按核准。A skill's value is not in its name but in the density of its rules. Using the attached SKILL.md as reference, write in four categories: **calculation rules** (how the achievement rate is derived, the four tier thresholds), **alert rules** (10 or more stock-outs, 5 or more complaints), **output structure** (six HTML sections, five email sections, primary and status colors), and **guardrails** (never introduce numbers absent from the source, write "not provided this week" rather than filling 0, and never use adjectives without a figure behind them). Guardrails are the most commonly skipped part, yet they decide whether the report can be sent as-is. ⚠️ There is one **operational step you must not miss** here: once the skill is written, Cowork presents a "copy files" approval card (copying the skill from the temporary working folder into the real skills folder), and **the skill is only published after you manually select Approve**. Many people assume it finishes on its own and navigate away — leaving the skill never actually created. When that card appears, check the Source and Destination paths, then approve.

提示詞Prompt
請把以下規則寫進技能：達成率 105% 以上為「領先」、95%～105% 為「符合預期」、85%～95% 為「落後」、低於 85% 為「嚴重落後」；缺貨次數 10 次以上一律列入下週優先處理；客訴件數 5 件以上須單獨列出並建議追查。HTML 報表依序包含標題列、總覽數字卡、店群分級區、門市績效表、需關注門市、下週優先處理事項，主色 #8A3A62。另外請加上防護欄：不得加入原始資料沒有的數字，缺少欄位要標示「本週未提供」而不是填 0，不使用沒有數據支撐的形容詞。Please write these rules into the skill: 105% and above is "Leading", 95%-105% "On plan", 85%-95% "Behind", below 85% "Severely behind"; 10 or more stock-outs always goes into next week's priority actions; 5 or more complaints must be listed separately with a recommendation to investigate. The HTML report contains, in order: header, summary cards, store tiers, store performance table, stores needing attention, and next week's priority actions, with primary color #8A3A62. Also add guardrails: never introduce numbers absent from the source data, mark missing fields as "not provided this week" rather than 0, and never use adjectives without a supporting figure.
3

看它自動評估技能品質，並讀懂那份技能報告Watch it evaluate the skill automatically and read the Skill Report

技能建立、更新或驗證時，Cowork 會自動評估並回傳一份「技能報告」，你不需要主動要求。評分為 0～100，分成四個各 25 分的面向：**觸發清晰度**（該啟動時會啟動）、**指示明確度**（知道要做什麼）、**範圍界線**（不越界做別的事）、**穩健度**（面對意外輸入不出事）。85 分以上為 Excellent、70～84 Good、50～69 Needs work、50 以下 Poor。若分數不理想，報告會直接列出最該修的幾點 —— 這一步請帶學員實際讀報告，而不是拿到分數就跳過。Whenever a skill is created, updated or validated, Cowork evaluates it automatically and returns a Skill Report — you do not need to ask. It scores 0 to 100 across four dimensions worth 25 points each: **trigger clarity** (it fires when it should), **instruction specificity** (it knows what to do), **scope boundaries** (it stays in its lane), and **robustness** (it handles unexpected input safely). Bands are Excellent at 85 and above, Good 70-84, Needs work 50-69, and Poor below 50. When the score is weak, the report lists the specific improvements that matter most — walk learners through actually reading it rather than glancing at the number and moving on.

4

開新工作階段實測：一句話換到 HTML 報表與 Email 摘要Test in a new session: one sentence, an HTML report and an email summary

這一步一定要**開新的工作階段**，因為技能是在每次工作階段開始時被自動探索載入的。在新階段裡只上傳原始數據、只講一句話，不要重述任何規則 —— 如果它自己就套用了分級門檻、把缺貨 12 次的桃園中壢店列進優先處理、把客訴 8 件的門市單獨標出，那才代表技能真的成立。這也是驗證你的描述觸發語句寫得夠不夠好的唯一方法。This step must happen in a **new session**, because skills are discovered and loaded at the start of each session. In the new session, upload only the raw data and say one sentence — do not restate any rules. If it applies the tier thresholds on its own, puts Taoyuan Zhongli (12 stock-outs) into priority actions and separately flags the store with 8 complaints, then the skill genuinely works. This is also the only real test of whether your trigger phrasing is good enough.

提示詞Prompt
附件是本週門市營運原始數據，請產生本週的門市營運週報。Attached is this week's store operations data. Please generate this week's store operations report.
5

檢查兩份產出，決定要不要分享給同事Review both outputs and decide whether to share the skill

打開 HTML 報表確認六個區塊是否齊全、達成率橫條是否對得上數字、桃園中壢店（71.4%）是否被標為嚴重落後；再看 Email 版摘要是否控制在一頁內。都沒問題後，可以到「自訂」頁的技能詳細頁按「分享」，選擇「僅自己」或「組織中的特定使用者」。注意：技能是以指示的形式執行的，Microsoft 不會驗證使用者自建技能的內容，所以分享前務必自己確認過輸出品質；之後每次修改技能，記得回到詳細頁按「重新分享」，同事那邊才會拿到最新版。Open the HTML report and check that all six sections are present, that the achievement bars match the figures, and that Taoyuan Zhongli (71.4%) is flagged as severely behind; then confirm the email summary fits within roughly one screen. Once satisfied, open the skill's detail page on the Customize page and select Share, choosing "Only you" or "Specific users in your organization." Note that a skill runs as instructions to the AI and Microsoft does not validate user-created skills, so verify the output quality yourself before sharing. After every later edit, return to the detail page and select Re-share so colleagues receive the updated version.

⚠️審核決策點Approval checkpoint

建立技能、產生 HTML 報表與 Email 摘要都屬於內部產出，不會觸發核准卡；只有當你進一步要求它把週報寄給主管或貼到 Teams 時，才會進入核准流程。但這個情境有另一層必須強調的責任：官方文件明確指出「使用者自建的技能不經 Microsoft 驗證，請仔細檢查輸出」。技能是以指示的形式交給 AI 執行的，因此只上傳你信任來源的技能檔，分享給同事前也要自己先確認輸出品質 —— 一份寫得不嚴謹的技能，會把錯誤標準化地複製到每一個用它的人身上。Creating the skill and producing the HTML report and email summary are internal output and trigger no approval card; only when you go on to email the report to your manager or post it in Teams does the approval flow apply. But this scenario carries another responsibility worth stressing: the documentation states plainly that "custom skills created by users are not validated by Microsoft — review custom skill outputs carefully." A skill runs as instructions to the AI, so only upload skills from sources you trust, and verify output quality yourself before sharing. A sloppily written skill standardizes its errors across everyone who uses it.

✅產出驗收Verify the result

  • 技能描述包含明確觸發語句，且有「Do NOT use for」排除條款避免與既有技能搶觸發The skill description contains explicit trigger phrasing plus "Do NOT use for" exclusions so it does not compete with existing skills
